---
title: "Why Hockey?"
format: html
execute: 
  echo: false
---


```{r}
library(stringr)
library(magrittr)

# 1. Define the Text
# We combine the content into a single string, using "\n" as markers for new paragraphs
why_hockey_text <- paste(
  "THE HOCKEY ADVANTAGE",
  "\n",
  "STRUCTURAL SUPERIORITY: Unlike other major sports that feature a single halftime",
  "or short quarter breaks, professional hockey offers a unique 'Double Peak' opportunity.",
  "The standard structure of two 18-minute intermissions creates two distinct,",
  "extended windows for transaction volume, effectively doubling the high-margin",
  "selling periods compared to football or soccer.",
  "\n",
  "DEMOGRAPHIC PREMIUM: Market analysis indicates that the hockey fan demographic",
  "indexes significantly higher in disposable income compared to general sports",
  "audiences. This 'Wallet Share' advantage correlates with a higher willingness to",
  "purchase premium food and beverage items, making per-capita yield optimization",
  "more responsive to strategic shifts in vendor operations.",
  "\n",
  "THE STOPPAGE ECONOMY: Hockey's unique pacing—characterized by high-variance",
  "stoppages (reviews, icing, equipment repairs)—creates frequent 'Micro-Breaks.'",
  "Our data suggests that these unpredictable pauses, particularly those driven by",
  "goaltender interactions, trigger impulse spending behaviors that static",
  "game structures fail to capture.",
  "\n",
  "CONCLUSION: The combination of predictable intermission spikes and exploitable",
  "stoppage variance makes hockey the ideal laboratory for testing David Kane's",
  "high-density vendor deployment strategy.",
  sep = " "
)

# 2. The Pipe for Professional Spacing
why_hockey_text %>% 
  
  # A. Split the text into separate paragraphs based on where we put "\n"
  str_split("\n") %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  
  # B. Wrap EACH paragraph individually to 80 width
  str_wrap(width = 80) %>% 
  
  # C. Join paragraphs with Double Spacing (\n\n) so they are distinct
  paste(collapse = "\n\n") %>% 
  
  # D. Print to console
  cat()
```
